en: Sepia-toned vintage view of a small European town. In the foreground are fenced fields and modest houses with pitched roofs. In the middle stands an ornate Orthodox-style church with onion domes. Behind it, on a wooded hill, are the ruins of a medieval castle with a round keep or tower. On the far right is a tall Lutheran-style church with a slender spire. The image is bordered like an old photographic postcard; no clear caption is visible within the picture area.
